notes: οὕτως … καί divided under rule 100: the adverb keeps 'Even so' whole and heads on 'so', while the particle takes the written 'also'. Splitting 'Even' onto καί would cross the alignment and is forbidden by rule 82.
οὐκ takes the clause-final 'not' discontinuously (rule 15); no second negative stands, so rules 41 and 59 are not in play.
ἐν takes 'unto' under rule 36, the expressed preposition being what the English word answers to.
